scenario_design: complete; 7 modality combinations x 4 positions at 30%; all modalities random at 10%,50%,70% (32 cases)
selection: classification maximizes weighted mean macro-F1; regression minimizes weighted mean MAE on pooled video-group OOF predictions; decision parameters selected on same OOF, scores are selection scores, not unbiased estimates
official_valid_policy: evaluate frozen selections and controlled ablations; do not automatically retune or pick a winner from official valid
official_test_policy: do not evaluate or select on official test; prior test was inspected and motivated this exploratory refinement
preprocessing: fit TF-IDF, semantic scaler, AV scalers on each fold training partition only; frozen generic encoder shared
